outcome: Obstetric haemorrhage (including abruptio placentae, placenta praevia, antepartum haemorrhage, and postpartum haemorrhage)
cohort: The study included 448 women diagnosed with obstetric haemorrhage at King Edward VIII Hospital in Durban, South Africa, between 2009 and 2011.
finding: The incidence of obstetric haemorrhage increased over the 3-year period, and postpartum haemorrhage was significantly associated with HIV seropositivity (OR 1.84), while cART was not associated with an increased risk of haemorrhage.
